senses.gloss: f. (<cite ref="R00432"><he>צִיץ</he></cite> ch.; of <cite ref="N01091"><he>נֵץ</he></cite> a. <cite ref="N00751"><he>נִיצוֹץ</he></cite>)

units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 73a:8">B. Bath. 73ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 337">Yalk. Is. 337</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 276:1">Yalk. Jer. 276</cite> <he>צ׳ דנ׳ חוורתי</he> a ray of whitish light.
<cite ref="Taanit 25a:11">Taan. 25ᵃ</cite> <he>נפיק צ׳ דנ׳ וכ׳</he> a ray of light proceeded from his forehead; (Ms. M. also <he>צָצוּתָא</he>).

Sabb. 56ᵇ נתן דצ׳ Nathan ‘with the ray of light’ (a repentant sinner with a halo; oth. opin. whom an angel seized by his forelock, v. infra, afterwards known as (Mar) Ukba, the Resh Galutha; v. Rashi to Snh. 31ᵇ).

<cite ref="Menachot 42a:3">Men. 42ᵃ</cite> <he>וצריך לפורדה כי צ׳ וכ׳</he> (Ms. R. 2, a. Rashi <cite ref="R00438"><he>צִיצִי׳</he></cite>) he must separate it (the show-fringe) like the forelock of the gentiles; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 750:5">Yalk. Num. 750</cite> <he>ציצו׳</he>.

<cite ref="Shabbat 121b:3">Sabb. 121ᵇ</cite> <he>נקוטו בצוּצִיתֵיה ואפקוה</he> (not <he>ואפקיה</he>) take it by its tail and carry it out; <cite ref="Beitzah 36b">Bets. 36ᵇ</cite> (corr. acc.; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 50).
